Predict exits from one exit type's model, with 0 where fixest dropped a level

dot-predict_exits.Rd

The prediction shared by both uses of predict.survival_model(): the expected exits, exp() of the band, year and covariate effects times the exposure in model_data. With exposure = 1 that is the hazard per year.

Usage

.predict_exits(model, model_data, cells)

Arguments

model

One fixest model from .survival_models().

model_data

A data.table with .band, .year (if the model has year effects), the covariates and exposure.

cells

The cells the model was fitted on, for the bands and years seen.

Value

A numeric vector, one value per row of model_data.

Details

fixest drops a tenure band or year in which no one left, since its effect is minus infinity: it predicts NA there. The model's estimate is 0 exits, so a band or year seen in the cells but dropped gets 0. One never seen, a covariate level never seen, or a missing value stays NA.
